recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Re-adding MedicationStatement-part-of would be a new current search parameter decision and should only be done after a fresh Pharmacy work-group request, not as reconciliation of this DSTU2 tracker.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification Pharmacy request for DSTU2 to address a MedicationStatement.part-of search parameter warning, add patient search parameters for MedicationRequest, MedicationDispense, and MedicationStatement, and fix part-of search parameter naming.
initial_application: Historical commit a504c1b697fe81488480665b00364efbd46982e6 recorded TR#12604 as adding patient search parameters to MedicationRequest and MedicationStatement. MedicationDispense already had a patient search row in the checked historical context, and generated R3/R4/R4B history carries MedicationStatement-part-of with code part-of and expression MedicationStatement.partOf.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini keeps MedicationDispense, MedicationRequest, and MedicationStatement active in the current build. The current search parameter bundles define patient entries for all three resources. Later R5 MedicationUsage/MedicationStatement work, including FHIR-38682, changed the current MedicationStatement source context; R5 and current build aggregated search parameter outputs do not expose MedicationStatement-part-of. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later conflicting instruction to restore it.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source hunk is needed because the patient search parameter portion is present and there is no current incorrectly named part-of search parameter to fix.

related_jiras.note: R5 rename from MedicationUsage back to MedicationStatement explains the later current-source context for MedicationStatement search parameters.
